request.subject: PORTRAIT:CULT:MASS

layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: consistent strategy-game camera, three-quarter view looking slightly down, the subject faces down and to the right (south-east), whole subject visible and centred on a transparent background, nothing cropped. The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.

Light: the sun is low in the south-west, at the bottom left of the image: faces turned to the left or to the viewer are lit, faces turned to the right are in shadow, snow is brightest on its left side, and nothing is lit from the right.

Class: one chunky cute creature map piece, a single living thing with big simple rounded rubbery shapes, big round eyes and a clear silhouette that reads at a glance, thick single-colour black outline; the whole creature is visible, and its lowest part is the lowest thing in the image. It holds no weapon and no tool.

layers.text: Subject: Gibbering Mass, a chunky cute low wide heap of rubbery deep-sea teal goo shown whole, colour #1f8f95 with shade #145f6b, wider than it is tall, covered in many small pale cream mouths, some open and babbling and some smiling, and a scatter of round pale yellow eyes of different sizes with black pupils, colour #ffe27a, with a few short fat tendrils at its base; no legs, no arms, no head, no collar, no hat; calm and silly, not scary; simple shapes and very few details.

Its shape is a lumpy heap of soft teal jelly slumped on the ground like a beanbag, drawn large and filling the whole width of the square, wider than it is tall. It has no head and no single face: about eight small open mouths with tiny cream teeth and a few small yellow eyes are scattered all over the heap, and the inside of every open mouth is dark teal, colour #145f6b. Short fat tendrils spread flat along the ground at its foot. Nothing on it glows green.
